name: Muck Rack
tagline: Muck Rack tracks press coverage across the web and maintains a searchable database of journalists and their beats, so PR teams can find the right reporter for a pitch instead of guessing. Its AI summarizes coverage sentiment and surfaces which outlets are picking up a story, which is the part of media relations that used to mean reading every article by hand.
